rows.section: Cantonal income tax tariff (Uri, Steuersätze 2012-2026 (flat rate, unchanged))
rows.label: Simple tax: rate on the whole taxable income
rows.basis: Taxable income, per year (simple tax, before the multipliers)
rows.note: Tariff vintage: Steuersätze 2012-2026 (flat rate, unchanged), per ESTV Kantonsblatt (Stand Februar 2026).

rows.label: Married couples and single parents
rows.value: One proportional rate for all taxpayers (Art. 42 StG has no separate married tariff)

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Altdorf; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Altdorf; other communes in Uri set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)
